name: @aemonge-dev/pi-openspec-gate
description: pi-openspec-gate — openspec, extended. Three human verbs (focus, approve, close) over openspec's new/archive via the eospec CLI, plus a Pi extension that accounts every mutating tool call: allowed by path, attributed to the aimed change, declared by the h
